name: Consistency & Conflict Analyzer
description: Agent 2 of the Intelligent Domain Architect pipeline. Validates Domain-Driven Design models for semantic consistency, detects conflicts between bounded contexts, identifies ambiguities, and generates clarification questions for business stakeholders. Produces a validated and refined domain model ready for microservice specification generation.

extensions.description: Domain-Driven Design validation rules and semantic analysis

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: JWT Bearer token for authentication between agents

skills.name: Domain Classification Validation
skills.description: Validates that domains are correctly classified as Core, Supporting, or Generic based on DDD principles. Detects misclassified domains and suggests corrections.
examples: Validate that the Order Management domain is correctly classified as Core
Check if Authentication should be Generic instead of Supporting
Verify domain classifications against DDD criteria

skills.name: Entity Overlap Detection
skills.description: Detects entities that appear in multiple bounded contexts without proper role differentiation. Identifies violations of the single source of truth principle.
examples: Find entities duplicated across domains
Detect if Product entity exists in both Order and Inventory contexts
Identify entities without clear ownership

skills.name: Requirement Conflict Detection
skills.description: Identifies contradicting requirements across domains. Detects logical conflicts, incompatible invariants, and temporal inconsistencies.
examples: Find conflicting requirements between Order and Payment domains
Detect if immutability rules conflict with modification requirements
Identify incompatible SLA requirements

skills.name: Semantic Ambiguity Detection
skills.description: Identifies unclear definitions, ambiguous terminology, and concepts that lack precise meaning within their bounded context.
examples: Find terms with unclear definitions
Detect ambiguous entity names like 'Transaction'
Identify concepts that could be interpreted multiple ways

skills.name: Event Architecture Validation
skills.description: Validates event-driven architecture patterns including single emitter rule, event naming conventions, and payload structure compliance.
examples: Check if each event has only one emitter
Validate event naming follows PastTense convention
Verify event payload contains required fields

skills.name: Communication Pattern Validation
skills.description: Validates that communication patterns between domains are compatible with their consistency and latency requirements.
examples: Check if sync/async patterns are compatible between domains
Validate that strong consistency requirements use appropriate patterns
Detect incompatible communication patterns

skills.name: Follow-up Question Generation
skills.description: Generates targeted clarification questions for business stakeholders based on detected issues and ambiguities.
examples: Generate questions to clarify entity ownership
Create questions about conflicting requirements
Produce questions to resolve ambiguous definitions

skills.name: Model Refinement
skills.description: Produces a validated and corrected version of the domain model with all detected issues resolved or documented.
examples: Refine domain model based on validation results
Apply suggested corrections to the model
Produce clean model ready for Agent 3

skills.name: Full Consistency Analysis
skills.description: Performs complete consistency and conflict analysis on a domain model, combining all validation skills into a comprehensive report.
examples: Analyze this domain model for all consistency issues
Perform complete DDD validation
Run full consistency check on the model
